carrier_definition.space: L2_loc(R,dt), or weighted L2(R,w(t)dt) for windowed probes
carrier_definition.operator: multiplication by Z(t) and real projection P_R f=(f+conj(f))/2

RH_equivalence_statement: Z(t) real-valued is a functional-equation identity, not RH. RH is equivalent to Delta_Z(T)=N(T)-N_0(T)=0 for all T, where N_0 counts real zeros of Z(t) on [0,T].
retained_nogos: Branch B precision limitations remain unaffected.
